correctness.rationale: Exhaustive all-6-subsets perfect-matching enumeration gives 52 facets and 1880 faces. Full 930-pair 1879-node acyclic Morse matching leaves exactly one 0-cell, seventeen 2-cells and one 3-cell. Exact integer recursive Morse differential from the critical 3-cell is zero; by Hurewicz the attaching sphere map is null, proving the integral wedge. Independent full mod-two boundary ranks 23,181,414,260,52 corroborate, but do not substitute for integral proof.

value.rationale: Chvátal is a canonical extremal four-chromatic triangle-free quartic graph. Its natural perfect-matching extendability complex has unexpected reduced integral homology in dimensions two and three despite being pure five-dimensional. The exact wedge detects nonshellability and contrasts with three-primary torsion in the distinct ordinary matching complex; the specific complete homotopy invariant is motivated by this natural comparison, without claiming a broader family theorem.
